up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613769. Return the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity type (standard_type), exact activity relation (standard_relation), exact activity value (standard_value), activity units (standard_units), and document ID (doc_id). Include all records; do not apply filters on units, relations, or target type.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.doc_id
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613769')
